title:
(1) Air Force Special Security Office Report, Northeast Air Command: UFOB NEAC Area. July 18, 1955
(2) Air Intelligence Information Report: Unidentified Flying Object Report, March 18, 1956
doc_notes: This document is a collection of Air Force Special Security Office reports regarding UAP sightings in the Northeast Air Command area during June and July 1955. / This document contains two distinct reports: an Air Force Special Security Office report from 1956 regarding a sighting near Harmon Field, and an Air Intelligence Information Report from 1958 regarding radar tracks in the Panama Canal Zone, plus a 1969 OPREP-4 report.

incidents.summary: RB-47 electronic contact with unknown object near Devon Island.
incidents.quote: bright return was received on the APG-32 set for 20 minutes

incidents.summary: RB-47 electronic and visual contact with glistening silver metallic object.
incidents.quote: crew chief, who describes aircraft as glistening silver metallic

incidents.summary: RB-47 electronic contact with small rectangular object.
incidents.quote: The pilot interpreted it to be a form of jamming

incidents.summary: RB-47 electronic and visual contact with fighter-configured object.
incidents.quote: co-pilot of RB-47 states aircraft had fighter configuration

incidents.summary: Multiple KC-97 crews and radar site observe hovering and high-speed objects.
incidents.quote: object was making a very irregular zig zag pattern

incidents.summary: KC-97 crew observed a bright light moving erratically and appearing stationary at times.
incidents.quote: IT LOOKED LIKE A VERY BRIGHT LIGHT, LIKE A STAR.

incidents.summary: Multiple radar tracks observed in the Canal Zone, some investigated by aircraft with negative results.
incidents.quote: Generally the tracks were triangular with speed of movement very erratic.

incidents.summary: Pan American Airlines pilot observed a large unidentified object.
incidents.quote: The object appeared larger than the aircraft and was traveling in a Southeasterly direction.

incidents.summary: RC-135 crew observed a bright white light rising from the horizon.
incidents.quote: A BRIGHT WHITE LIGHT APPEARED IN THE NORTH JUST ABOVE THE HORIZON.
